V-hist-fail.definition: the 16 issued-command contents := the donor failure world history at the same release-relative tick; target timestamps kept (same replace_history as V-hist)
V-hist-fail.delta_definition: mean over the 80 window ticks of mean |issued PWM difference| over the 16 history entries x 5 servos, target vs donor at the same release-relative tick (history_delta_series / window_history_delta)
V-hist-fail.donor_rule: candidates = failure worlds whose seed differs from the target seed (kind not constrained); donor = candidate with the largest mean history |dPWM| against the target; ties broken by world label order
V-hist-fail.recorded: per target: donor label and its mean |dPWM| (summary addendum.hist_fail_donors); distributions of V-hist and V-hist-fail |dPWM| over the 10 failure worlds (summary addendum.history_delta)
V-hist-fail.runtime_check: the replay recomputes the donor table from the C2c observations and aborts if any donor or |dPWM| (tol 1e-3) differs from hist_fail_donor
V-hist-fail.scope: failure worlds only (10); not applicable to success worlds

V-hist-scramble.definition: the 16 issued-command contents := the V-hist donor history (same-kind success reference img_same, same release-relative tick) permuted: entries reversed in time, then entry index rotated by k=8 (scrambled[i] = reversed[(i + 8) mod 16]); target timestamps kept
V-hist-scramble.property: a pure permutation of the donor entries: per channel the donor multiset of values (value distribution) is identical to V-hist; only temporal order changes
V-hist-scramble.recorded: per world |dPWM| of V-hist and V-hist-scramble, their distributions, the ratio and size_matched flag (summary addendum.history_delta)
V-hist-scramble.scope: all 19 worlds, like V-hist (failure 10 enter the decision; success 9 descriptive)

size_check.on_fail: h_a1_scramble verdict withheld_size_mismatch (no conclusion from the scramble rule)
size_check.rule: scramble_size_ratio = median(V-hist-scramble) / median(V-hist) must lie in [0.80, 1.25]
size_check.statistic: median over the 10 failure worlds of mean |dPWM| vs the target (same definition as V-hist-fail)

amends.reason: v2 V-hist-fail is expected to be flagged unsuitable (input-only median ratio 0.27); a size-matched content control is added
amends.unchanged: everything in v2 (including V-hist-fail, its donor table and its suitability rule); v3 only adds V-hist-scramble, its size check and its decision rule

H-A1: suitability: if median |dPWM|(V-hist-fail) < 0.5 x median |dPWM|(V-hist) over the 10 failure worlds, V-hist-fail is marked unsuitable as a control (verdict control_unsuitable); the H-A1 report then gives the V-hist recovery count alone together with the donor sizes, without a content-specificity claim
otherwise: V-hist >= 6 and V-hist-fail < 6 -> supported (success-history content)
otherwise: V-hist >= 6 and V-hist-fail >= 6 -> refuted as content-specific (any history change recovers)
H-A1-scramble: V-hist >= 6/10 and V-hist-scramble <= 2/10 -> temporal_content: the temporal structure (content) of the success history is the cause
V-hist >= 6/10 and V-hist-scramble >= 6/10 -> perturbation_ood_escape: a large history perturbation itself is the cause
reported alongside the v2 H-A1 (V-hist-fail) verdict; neither replaces the other
H-A2: any alternative executor recovers >= 6/10 on V0 forwards -> supported (TE dilution)
no executor >= 6 and V0 chunk_open = 0/10 failure worlds -> refuted (no open in raw chunks)
otherwise -> not supported; masked_by_te rate is reported as the H-A2 indicator
decision.carry_tournament_link: H-A1 refuted or not supported -> drop carry-cand-1/2 from tournament A; H-A2 refuted -> drop carry-cand-3; freed slots filled from the strongest C4b-GPU signal before the tournament prereg is frozen (owner plan A3)

exclusions_and_limits: offline replay; no physics; no closed loop (as in the base prereg)
V-hist-fail is not applicable to success worlds; success-world tables for it are empty by design

V-hist-fail donors are failure worlds, whose release histories are all near-stationary; even the largest different-seed donor is much smaller than the success-history substitution of V-hist (see precomputed_input_sizes)
v2 donors concentrate on two worlds (C2c-ho4-rep1/group-002/world-001 for 7 targets, C2c-ho4-rep3/group-001/world-000 for 3)

V-hist-scramble keeps every donor value, including open-level PWM values once the success donor has opened (late window ticks); in those ticks the scrambled history can still contain an open command, so a scramble recovery after the donor open time is not pure perturbation

the permutation changes the donor content by a median mean |dPWM| of 43.3 against the unscrambled donor (failure targets), about 22% of the V-hist substitution size: much of the donor history is stationary, so the content break is partial
for C2c-train4-rep2/group-000/world-000 (success, self-reference) V-hist == V0 (|dPWM| 0) while V-hist-scramble is 43.6; success worlds are descriptive only

execution.run_root: new run root only: <vm>/runs/act18/c4b-gpu-<UTC>; never the CPU partial run root
execution.vm_hours_estimate: 0.3-0.5 (extrapolated from CPU 0.81 s/forward; not measured) [확인 필요]
execution.worlds: all 19 registered worlds re-run on GPU (the CPU-completed world is re-run, not reused)

metrics.H-A2_masked_by_te: number and rate of FAILURE worlds (V0 arm, N=10) whose raw chunk contains an open row (chunk_open_tau not null) while the deployed TE pwm1 never reaches 1900 in the window; also reported per arm and for success worlds (descriptive)
metrics.executor_recovered: per alternative executor: failure worlds with open under that executor on the V0 forwards and no TE open under V0
metrics.hist_fail_recovered: failure worlds with TE open under V-hist-fail and no TE open under V0
metrics.history_delta_distribution: n, median, min, max and per-world values of mean |dPWM| for V-hist and V-hist-fail over the failure worlds

no_pooling: the CPU partial result (1/19 world, outputs/runs/act18-c4b-counterfactual-20261020T0505Z) is a separate cpu_replay condition and is never pooled with or substituted into the GPU result
the V0 fidelity gate (19/19 open status, exact >= 0.95, max|d| <= 1) is applied to the GPU replay alone; GPU float differences that break it abort the report (no CPU fallback)
a CPU-vs-GPU comparison on the one CPU world may be shown as a descriptive footnote only

alternative_executors.definition: (b) open tick when the recorded raw chunks are executed by harness ChunkExecutor with temporal_ensemble_coeff=None (latest chunk first, unweighted): a new chunk is taken only when the queue is empty and its first n_action_steps rows are executed in order; a done row clears the queue and later ticks hold the last issued command. Reset at release entry.
notes: latest4 = the carry-cand-3 release executor; latest8 = execute the full 8-row chunk without averaging
ticks after the deployed TE arm requested done have no forward; such series are truncated and truncated_at_tau is reported (counts per executor in the summary)
offline only: executed alternative commands do not change later recorded observations

raw_chunk_open.definition: (a) first release-relative tick whose raw predicted chunk (any of its 8 rows, contract.decode_action) has pwm1 >= 1900, and the row index of the first such row
raw_chunk_open.name: chunk_open_tau / chunk_open_row

offline_aggregates.source: the same forward outputs as the deployed-TE replay of every arm; no additional forward
